evals.prompt: Create a two-page HTML migration plan with shared CSS and publish it to our internal artifact server using slug migration-plan. Give me the stable link.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained files with relative links; create operation; stable and snapshot URLs recorded.

evals.prompt: Download the current migration-plan artifact, add a checklist, and publish an update at its existing link. Check for newer remote revisions first.
evals.expected_output: Original-byte download, revision check, same-slug update with conflict detection, new immutable version.

evals.prompt: Compare versions 1 and 2 of migration-plan and explain what changed. My last upload response was lost; retry that saved upload before comparing.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the saved operation key, then compare manifests and text patches without a duplicate publication.

evals.prompt: Find the recently updated migration plan, fix its catalog description without changing the HTML, and keep its current content version.
evals.expected_output: Search or recent discovery, inspect revision, metadata-only edit, unchanged latestVersion with a new concurrency revision.

evals.prompt: Publish an HTML report with a useful title and summary, and make sure it gets a preview in the library. This agent machine has no browser installed.
evals.expected_output: Publish using the standalone CLI; server generates the preview asynchronously; no client-side browser setup or screenshot generation.
